tasks_scope: two distinct tiny graph intervention tasks; controlled references, not therapeutic or architecture generalization

function_splits.sampling: independent coefficients for seven monomials, standard normal; intercept zero; each independent seed defines two predictor variants sharing first-order coefficients, with independent higher-order coefficients
function_splits.independent_unit: base coefficient draw; matched variants form one cluster
function_splits.prohibited: test model identity, labels, weights or test errors in explainer inputs or selection
function_splits.exact_rng: numpy.default_rng(numpy.random.SeedSequence([split seed_start, index, task_index])); task_index edge_switch=0,node_state=1; first normal(3), then normal((2,4))[variant]
function_splits.training_function_family_limit: Independent Gaussian monomial prior has a known Bayes conditional mean. A learned model has no expected squared-error advantage over that mean at identical observations under the declared generator; these are correctness controls.

graph_splits.primary: held-out predictor functions on fixed task templates
graph_splits.secondary: held-out graph-feature seeds; topology and architecture extrapolation not established

fixed_queries.random_control: Identity first, then seed-91226 permutation of seven nonidentity actions; same actions across every compared method.
fixed_queries.target_actions: all seven nonidentity states, with queried/unqueried strata additionally reported

future_training.selection: fixed schedule; no test-driven reruns; no model zoo

baseline_selection.rule: lowest development primary AUC among applicable baselines, frozen before test
baseline_selection.feature_scaling: fit on source training states only, frozen; do not load unverified published scaler
baseline_selection.known_prior_gp: no development tuning; full order-three monomial features, iid unit coefficient prior, noiseless pseudoinverse

primary.name: normalized_response_MSE_area_under_total_runtime_curve
primary.normalization: per-task sqrt(mean(v**2)) over all seven nonidentity actions, 64 training function clusters, both variants and eight training graph seeds; floor 1e-6
primary.integration: piecewise constant error integrated exactly over log seconds, divided by log(upper/lower)
primary.cold_cache: charged on first computation; warm reuse reported separately
primary.default_before_first_output: zero effect for every action; timeouts retain last output
primary.continuation_target: at least 10% relative improvement in EACH task vs development-selected strongest applicable baseline and paired 95% CI for improvement lower bound >0
primary.uncertainty: 10000 paired cluster bootstrap replicates over 32 independent function seeds per task; matched model variants grouped; seed 91226; graph seed set fixed
primary.aggregate: equal weight across task means; individual task gates remain mandatory
primary.initialization_aggregation: Mean the three separately run initialization AUCs within function/variant/graph; no ensemble inference or best-seed selection. All nine training runs charged to upfront project cost and allocated per method using its own three runs.
primary.independent_unit_reduction: Average within each function cluster across two matched variants, four held-out graph-feature seeds, and initialization runs; bootstrap the resulting 32 paired units per task.

exclusions: unmapped fragment correspondence for atom claims

stop_rules: same operator as generic CNP: no new-architecture claim
exact evaluation wins: stop efficiency claim in that regime
query removal/shuffling does not hurt: investigate information leakage before any conclusion
generic capacity-matched CNP matches: novelty unproven
one task fails: no aggregate-only continuation
weak GNN: no therapeutic utility claim from fidelity
no endpoint/split/threshold change after held-out outcomes
Known-prior posterior and exhaustive evaluation are mandatory reference controls; no positive claim based on excluding them.
